03 / THE DECISION LOGIC

Interest is the beginning.
Trust does the work.

From STP to the funnel: a plan built around reassurance and transparency.

A

Choose the person.

SEGMENT → TARGET → POSITION

Indian Gen Z, 19–27. Domestic hosted group trips, ₹7,000–₹25,000: Goa, Himachal, Meghalaya, Rajasthan and North East.

  • First-time solo joiner
  • Budget-conscious planner
  • Warm but undecided waitlist contact

ICP hypotheses, not interview findings.

Position: reassurance and transparency, not lowest price. Exclude blanket youth reach, luxury and fully customised trips.

B

Give channels a job.

Search
Capture existing intent within 30% impression share.
Meta / Reels
Interest + ICP proof tests. Lookalikes are a possible test, with no assumed uplift.
Creators
Authentic explanation. ₹2 lakh/quarter; ₹8 lakh/year inside ₹30 lakh.
YouTube
Existing footage only.
CRM
35,000 opted-in contacts. At most one promotion/month. No paid halo.
C

Respect the drop-offs.

Base Meta media funnel · social interest ≠ booking intent.

Quarterly base / expected versus capacity.

Positioning hypothesis to test · Against MakeMyTrip group packages, Thrillophilia group tours and WanderOn: can a young traveller answer safety, group fit, total cost and cancellation before paying? No competitor prices or policies are assumed.

04 / THE PLANNING SANDBOX

Change the assumptions.
Follow the consequences.

Planned figures, not campaign actuals.
Every lever uses the same dataset.

Meta’s conversion staircase

Media only · test uplift limited to the ₹3 lakh tranche

9.33 million impressions can exceed 6 million reachable audience through repeated exposure. This is not unique reach.

Bookings versus available capacity

Solid = expected · outline = cap · numerical labels show overflow

Paid pacing: 20% / 35% / 15% / 30%. Creators: ₹2 lakh each quarter. Annual mix has one more Q3 CRM promotion than the quarterly base.

Channel economics
ChannelPlanned spendBookingsCACGross ROAS

Creators are a separate cost with no independently attributed bookings. Blended CAC includes creators. CRM costs are unknown and excluded from the stated ₹30 lakh allocation; CRM CAC is unpriced.

CRM concentration is the central planning risk.

Every priced paid CAC exceeds ₹1,667.Search cannot fill capacity at 30% impression share.

ROAS measures gross booking value.It is not profit, nor a choice of Target ROAS bidding.

THE CMO ASK / CONDITIONAL

1,250 travellers.
The same ₹30 lakh.

Ring-fence ₹3 lakh inside the existing ₹14 lakh Meta media for conversion tests. The Year-1 ask is conditional on validated CRM rephasing into spare capacity and/or further conversion gains.

EVIDENCE GATES / EACH QUARTER

  • Unique travellers and booking CAC
  • Funnel by ICP, creative and landing page
  • CRM fatigue and opt-in health
  • Available trip capacity

A new brand may need a bounded maximize-conversions test on a real booking event before Target ROAS bidding is credible.

The rejected path + model notes

Constant-CAC illustration, not a feasible reach forecast. Exact annual gap ~563.39 would imply ~₹1.42 crore. We do not recommend buying 1,800 by scaling at current Meta media CAC.
